data.scalars_csv: data/magnet/igse_predictions.csv (columns used: sample_id, frequency_Hz, temperature_C, amplitude_T, waveform, measured_W_m3)
data.b_waveform_npy: data/magnet/N87/B.npy (40616 x 1024, float64, one period, endpoint excluded)
data.simulator: pool lookup: querying a pool sample_id reveals its measured y; nothing else

features.duty: mean(diff_periodic(B) > 0)  (fraction of samples with rising flux)
features.plateau: existing magnet_igse.classify plateau fraction: mean(|diff| < 0.1 * quantile(|diff|, 0.9))
features.shape: log10( mean( (|diff_periodic(B)| * 1024 * f)^1.5 ) / (4 * f * Bpk)^1.5 ), i.e. log10(mean(|dB/dt|^1.5) / (4 f Bpk)^1.5)
features.cell_for_mixed: dBdt_bin: 8 equal-width bins of log10(4*f*Bpk) [T/s] over [min,max] of the POOL (computed from inputs at design time); bin = clip(floor(8*(x-min)/(max-min)), 0, 7)
features.f_setpoint: sort unique frequency_Hz; start a new cluster whenever log(f_i/f_{i-1}) > 0.01; setpoint = round(median(cluster)/1000) kHz (20 setpoints expected: 50..446 kHz)
features.family: excitation family = f_setpoint + waveform + round(10*duty) + round(20*plateau); i.e. one waveform shape at one frequency, swept over amplitude and all 4 temperatures (291 families expected)

split.H: int(first 8 hex chars of the prereg commit SHA, 16)
split.X7_rule: extrapolation region: frequency_Hz >= 200000 AND amplitude_T >= 0.10 (identical to round-6 corner, 632 samples, all 4 temperatures); removed ENTIRELY from pool and calibration
split.ok_families: families with no sample in X7, sorted by family key string
split.G7_CAL7: rng=np.random.default_rng(H); perm=rng.permutation(ok_families_sorted); G7 = all samples of perm[:40]; CAL7 = all samples of perm[40:60]
split.pool: all samples minus X7 minus G7 minus CAL7
split.R_k: np.random.default_rng(H + 100 + k).choice(sorted(pool minus S0_k), 120, replace=False); order = acquisition order

model.name: M2-magnet: OLS linear mean on linear_mean_features + residual GP on standardized gp_inputs + sigma-normalized split conformal
model.scaler: sklearn StandardScaler fit on the arm's current training gp_inputs
model.conformal: scores |y - mu| / sigma on CAL7 (all samples of 20 held-out families); q = ceil((n+1)(1-alpha))-th smallest score; interval mu +/- q*sigma
model.refit: hyperparameters re-optimized at every batch and for the final model
model.note: identical to round 6 M2-magnet except calibration set

acquisition.candidates: pool minus S0_k minus points already selected by this arm
acquisition.A: kriging believer on GP posterior std incl. WhiteKernel (as round 3): within a batch, hyperparameters and y normalization fixed, Cholesky augmented with each chosen point; pick argmax sigma; tie -> lowest sample_id
acquisition.M: same believer, score = sigma / sqrt(1 + a_c), a_c = number of points already selected by this arm (excluding S0) in the candidate's dBdt_bin (8 bins)

metrics.coverage: count of y in [mu - q sigma, mu + q sigma]
metrics.winkler: mean Winkler score, alpha=0.1, log10 units: (U-L) + (2/alpha)(L-y)[y<L] + (2/alpha)(y-U)[y>U]
metrics.relative_error: median over set of |10^mu - P| / P

tests.type: exact one-sided sign-flip over K=20 pair differences: p = #{s in {-1,+1}^20 : mean(s*d) >= mean(d) - 1e-12} / 2^20 (identity included, ties counted)
tests.gatekeeping: fixed sequence; stop at first non-rejection; later 'not tested'

validity.per_arm: C1: G7 coverage >= ceil(0.8*|G7|); C2: X7 coverage >= 506/632 AND mean width(X7) <= 3 * mean width(G7)
validity.CV_X: >= 17 of 20 arms of method X pass C1 and C2

report_only: iGSE baseline median relative error on X7 / G7
learning curves after each batch b=0..6 (R uses first 20b points)
per-arm q, MAE, bias, coverage, width; frontier points selected (outside X7 with frequency_Hz >= 150000 and amplitude_T >= 0.07); dBdt_bin distribution
all pair differences, mean/median/IQR of d, count of positive pairs; nominal p of untested hypotheses

execution.memory_watchdog: pause when MemAvailable < 3.8 GiB, resume when > 4.3 GiB
